strings.help_text:
BASIC SHAPE
app:
  name: My app
pages:                  # each page = a tab
  - title: Ping
    items:              # page elements, top to bottom
      - field: site     # input field
        label: Site
        type: host      # text | host | number | choice
        placeholder: google.com   # faint hint while the field is empty
        default: ""               # default value (optional)
      - button: Start
        run: ping {site} -c 4     # {site} is taken from the field

FIELDS
type: text    any text (escaped automatically)
type: host    IP or domain only
type: number  integer only
type: choice  options: { IPv4: "-4", IPv6: "-6" }

BUTTONS AND COMMANDS
- button: Title
  run: command            # one command
  confirm: true           # ask first (or confirm: "your text")
  reboot: true            # after the command, wait for the reboot and reconnect

COMMAND CHAINS AND FALLBACKS
  run:
    - cmd: systemctl start ssh
      ok_if: ""           # text that must appear in the reply (else failure)
      fail_if: "not found" # text that marks failure if present
      fallback:           # runs if this step failed
        - /etc/init.d/dropbear start
    - cmd: echo done
      when: ok            # ok (default) | failed | always
      when_contains: ""   # run only if the previous reply contains this text
      when_not_contains: ""
A step fails if exit code is not 0, ok_if is missing or fail_if is present.

PROGRESS BAR
- progress: Memory
  source: memory          # memory | disk
  path: /tmp              # disk only (default /overlay or /)
  unit: auto              # auto | KB | MB | GB
  # or your own: run: a command printing 'total used' in bytes

SERVICE LIST (OpenWrt, built automatically)
- services: openwrt

LANGUAGES
Folder lang: ru.json, en.json. Your own: copy a file, translate the values (keep the keys), press “＋” next to the language selector. name = display name, flag = flag emoji, strings = translations.
